sentences.text: The Independent Commission Against Corruption evaluated SAFECOM, the Country Fire Service, Metropolitan Fire Service and State Emergency Service to help prevent corruption arising from conflicts of interest.
The evaluation examined how policies and procedures for managing conflicts of interest were developed, reviewed, communicated and enforced.
The Commission acknowledged improvements across all four agencies, including their adoption of a common policy for disclosing and managing conflicts.
However, the Commission concluded that none of the agencies complied with that policy and that it was not effectively implemented or enforced.
The Commission also found gaps in written communication and training for staff, volunteers and contractors.
It made 25 recommendations covering policies and procedures, communication, training, monitoring and compliance in managing conflicts of interest.

items.quote: The emergency services sector lacks consistent, clear and adequate guidance regarding the identification, disclosure and management of conflicts of interests.

The nature of induction and other training materials available to staff, volunteers and contractors in all agencies about their obligations to identify and disclose conflicts of interests requires improvement.
Only the MFS has a general conflict of interests disclosure form for employees to complete if they identify that they have any conflicts related to their work.

All four emergency services agencies have taken positive steps in recent years to improve management of conflicts of interests, including endorsing a generally sound Conflict of Interest and Disclosure Policy which applies uniformly across the sector.
